$comment: NetJarvis mock lab. FIXTURE DATA - not a real network. Loaded only when NETJARVIS_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE is set; every investigation built from it is banner-labelled 'FIXTURE'. One representative device per SOC platform the investigation agent must correlate, plus the campus switches the DevNet sandbox exposes so network fixtures line up with real hostnames.

devices.name: vpn-asa-1
devices.note: Cisco ASA 5516-X running AnyConnect remote-access VPN; syslog to Splunk sourcetype cisco:asa.

devices.name: fw-pan-1
devices.note: Palo Alto PA-3260 internet edge; traffic + threat logs to Splunk sourcetype pan:traffic / pan:threat.

devices.name: proxy-zs-1
devices.note: Zscaler ZIA tenant; NSS web feed to Splunk sourcetype zscalernss-web.

devices.name: lb-f5-1
devices.note: F5 BIG-IP i5800 in front of internal apps; present for scope/inventory realism, no evidence feed in this lab.

devices.name: edr-crowdstrike
devices.note: CrowdStrike Falcon tenant; sensor events via Falcon Data Replicator to Splunk.

devices.name: idp-okta
devices.note: Okta org (corp.example); System Log via Splunk Add-on for Okta, sourcetype OktaIM2:log.

devices.name: dc-ad-1
devices.note: Active Directory DC; Security event log (4624/4625/4768) to Splunk sourcetype XmlWinEventLog:Security.

devices.name: aws-prod-account
devices.note: AWS account 123456789012; CloudTrail management events to Splunk.

devices.name: splunk-es
devices.note: Splunk ES search head; notable events from correlation searches in index=notable.

devices.name: LT-4421
devices.note: Corporate laptop assigned to jdoe; VPN-assigned address 10.20.0.7 in this scenario.

devices.name: sw1
devices.note: Catalyst 9000v access switch (matches the DevNet sandbox hostname); syslog to Splunk.

devices.note: Catalyst 9000v access switch (matches the DevNet sandbox hostname).
